description: Defaults for every repository of the family: the recommended base, a sign-off line on the commits of the bot, three days of waiting after a release except for a fix of a known vulnerability, no edit mark for the generated-file commits of the merge-train app, no merge by the bot, and no proposal for the machine a job runs on.

packageRules.description: Which release of a hosted machine a job runs on is decided in the repository, not proposed.
